turns.speaker: Operator
turns.line: Living papers only. Pretend you sit. Classical NS. Keep 1/r^4. Leftover knobs are scored. Where now? Can X close?

turns.speaker: Tao
turns.line: The problem is supercritical. A cover of shells is not a bound. An averaged cousin can blow. That does not prove NS blows, and it does not let this catalog close X.

turns.speaker: Sverak
turns.line: Honest remaining doors: Liouville, ancient, self-similar. Energy plus a regime split is not those doors. Possible is not a theorem. Impossible is not a theorem.

turns.speaker: Seregin
turns.line: Local regularity and the ESS endpoint sit. They are criteria. They are not an a priori on X. Do not promote small singular set to empty.

turns.speaker: Caffarelli
turns.line: Small is not empty. I am living. Olga is not in this room. Do not slide her epsilon onto this equation.

turns.speaker: Kohn
turns.line: Parabolic measure zero is not no blowup. A decaying box is not no blowup either.

turns.speaker: Constantin
turns.line: CONC is a spectrum statement. Our theorem is if aligned. The if is still an if. Concentration is not alignment.

turns.speaker: Fefferman
turns.line: Do not glue Ring to Biot-Savart. Pretty-damn-close is that glue. We will not say the slogan so the table feels finished.

turns.speaker: Beale
turns.line: Continuation is the max. L2 is not our theorem. A leftover list is not the max.

turns.speaker: Koch
turns.line: Small critical data sits. Large data is a different job. Do not export Koch-Tataru onto this packet class.

turns.speaker: Tataru
turns.line: The critical space is the scaling wall. Energy class is a derivative short. That is why leftover knobs died.

turns.speaker: Grujic
turns.line: Sparseness can shrink the scaling gap. Finite order does not make the gap vanish. Asymptotic criticality is not a closed estimate.

turns.speaker: Vicol
turns.line: Wild weak solutions can be non-unique. That is a different class. Convex integration does not blow a smooth X, and it does not bound one.

turns.speaker: Buckmaster
turns.line: Non-uniqueness below the energy class is not a smooth blowup. Do not cash us as a killing field for classical X.

turns.speaker: Elgindi
turns.line: A singularity for Euler is a different equation. Viscosity is not a limit I will lend you. Euler does not write NS.

turns.speaker: Hou
turns.line: A computed almost-singular scenario is a probe. It is not an a priori. Do not spawn n=64 to finish the sentence.

turns.speaker: current math.AP
turns.line: An announcement is a proposal. Score one identity here or the title stays a paragraph. Shahmurov does not sit.

turns.speaker: Operator
turns.line: One sentence. Where now. Can X close.

turns.speaker: Tao
turns.line: Where now: a residual. A closed estimate, a killing field, or one preprint identity. Not another leftover close.

turns.speaker: Sverak
turns.line: Can X close? Unknown. That is the problem. Do not vote yes. Do not vote impossible.

turns.speaker: Fefferman
turns.line: Geometry waits. The object stayed X. Sit down on the knobs.
